headline: Passage Sees Eight Flips as Line and Expanse Stir
war_summary: Since the 06:16 edition the Passage has furnished the sharpest action, with eight changes in two hours to 08:37 for twenty-one on the day about The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post, now standing nine Warden and one Colonial with day losses of 10,637 Colonial and 11,401 Warden. The Shelf follows with three changes in two hours to 08:16 for sixteen on the day, now one Warden, seven Colonial and one unheld about Briar, with 3,247 and 3,556 losses. The Expanse reports two changes in two hours to 09:00 for thirty-nine on the day, holding seven Colonial and two unheld about Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, with 5,186 and 8,803 losses. The Nevish Line counts one change in two hours to 07:16 for fifty on the day at five Warden and three Colonial, with 4,011 and 4,198 losses. Stonecradle, Palantine Berm and Mooring County show no changes in two hours, Stonecradle last heard at 05:45 with ten on the day at two Warden and seven Colonial, while Palantine rests at thirty-five on the day since 00:59 and Mooring at three since 00:11 despite heavy late casualties.
